items.headline: O launches GPT-6.1 Terra
items.summary: O introduced GPT-6.1 Terra, emphasizing computer-use and visual reasoning. It lists API pricing ($1/M input; $5/M output) and claims cost/capability gains vs GPT-5.6 Terra and other GPT-6 models for agentic work.

items.headline: O expands GPT-6 + Intelligent UI to more users
items.summary: O announced GPT-6 in ChatGPT with “Intelligent UI” enabling interactive UI elements (graphics, buttons, forms, charts) inside responses; positioned for broad ChatGPT usage expansion beyond paid tiers.

items.headline: O executes follow-on third tranche investment
items.summary: SBG executed the third and final $10.0B tranche of its 2026 follow-on investment in O via SoftBank Vision Fund 2, totaling $30.0B follow-on investments completed; cumulative investment reaches $64.6B.
